editorial: Super follows Frank Darbo, a regular guy whose wife Sarah leaves him for a drug dealer named Jacques. After a strange vision, Frank decides to become a superhero called Crimson Bolt, armed with a wrench and a lot of determination. He has no powers, no training, and no real plan, but he is dead serious about fighting crime. Along the way he meets Libby, a comic shop worker who becomes his eager sidekick Boltie. The movie mixes dark humor with shocking violence, so it feels like a twisted take on superhero stories. Rainn Wilson plays Frank with a mix of sadness and intensity that keeps you watching. The tone swings between funny and disturbing, which may not work for everyone. If you like dark comedies and do not mind gore, this is a wild ride worth taking. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Frank storms Jacques's house to rescue Sarah. Libby is killed during the shootout, and Frank kills Jacques and his men. Sarah is freed from her drug addiction and returns home, but later leaves Frank again. Frank accepts this and moves on, finding peace. The final twist is that Frank has one last vision where he imagines Sarah still with him, showing he has made peace with losing her. He continues his quiet life, having done what he set out to do.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and twisted superhero stories.
